Instagram About the Area Ponte Vedra Beach: Situated between Jacksonville and St. Augustine TPC Sawgrass is proud to call picturesque Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida home. Situated between Jacksonville and St. Augustine, the area provides the perfect blend of small town charm and big city sophistication. Known for its outdoor ambiance, Ponte Vedra Beach is graced with miles of white sandy beaches that provide beachgoers year-round opportunities to enjoy the abundant Florida sunshine and a variety of water sports. Superb restaurants and shopping venues for all tastes can be found along the A1A corridor and one of north Florida’s largest malls, the St. John’s Town Center, is only 10 minutes away. The nearby city of Jacksonville, home of the NFL’s Jaguars, offers visitors an abundance of attractions including the Cummer Museum of Art, the Museum of Science and History, and the Jacksonville Zoo and Gardens. Not too far to the south, the town of St. Augustine offers the visitor a wonderful opportunity to walk the cobble stoned streets and shop the old town where early Spanish settlers roamed hundreds of years ago. A visit to the 17th Century Castillo de San Marco, the San Sebastian Winery, and Florida’s #1 Guided Tour – the Ghost Tours of St. Augustine will provide and unforgettable experience.
